what: The 120 topological obstructions in the website release 2026-11-11 absent from the 250,815-graph Myrvold collection. Exactly 22 are minor obstructions. N1.1-N1.13 retain their original records. N1.14 is T74. Every other graph has recorded K5 branch sets. The original website evidence and completed exact genus search records are bundled in N1_sources.json.gz. Their input and output checks do not rerun the exhaustive searches.
